title: One set of controls: Canada
kaylee: At the campfire there's one row of stars, not two: the marshmallow orders fill the top bar's stars, and pink dashes under them show how far through the campfire she is. The five "again" buttons are lavender with the drawn again picture, the animal book closes with the same white button as everywhere else, and the stars in every country are drawn now instead of the iPad's emoji. Stars also stop going missing when she reopens a game she's already played.
